items.text: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) is out; Tanner McKee starts (already the listed starter in the model).
Philadelphia is also without RB Saquon Barkley, RB Will Shipley, DB Michael Carter II and OLB Jalyx Hunt; OLB A.J. Epenesa is doubtful and G Landon Dickerson questionable.
Carolina is without RB AJ Dillon; OT Monroe Freeling is doubtful and OT Taylor Moton, G Damien Lewis and OLB Jaelan Phillips are questionable.
Philadelphia gets WR DeVonta Smith (toe) back after two missed games. The Eagles do not plan to put Jalen Hurts on IR.

adjust.reason: Philadelphia's top two running backs and two defensive starters are out on top of the QB change; Carolina's OL is banged up but mostly questionable. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
